usage.text:
The door starts open and a damped hinge spring pulls it shut, then holds it against its lower stop.

<mujoco model="self_closing_door">
  <compiler angle="radian"/>
  <option timestep="0.002"/>
  <statistic center="0 0 1" extent="3"/>

  <worldbody>
    <light name="overhead_light" pos="0 -2 4" dir="0 0 -1"/>
    <geom name="floor" type="plane" size="4 4 0.1" rgba="0.65 0.68 0.70 1" friction="1 0.005 0.0001"/>

    <body name="door_frame" pos="0 0 0">
      <geom name="frame_left" type="box" pos="-0.58 0 1.08" size="0.06 0.08 1.08" contype="0" conaffinity="0" rgba="0.25 0.28 0.32 1"/>
      <geom name="frame_right" type="box" pos="0.58 0 1.08" size="0.06 0.08 1.08" contype="0" conaffinity="0" rgba="0.25 0.28 0.32 1"/>
      <geom name="frame_top" type="box" pos="0 0 2.13" size="0.64 0.08 0.06" contype="0" conaffinity="0" rgba="0.25 0.28 0.32 1"/>
      <geom name="hinge_upper" type="cylinder" pos="-0.5 0 1.75" size="0.045 0.09" contype="0" conaffinity="0" rgba="0.6 0.62 0.65 1"/>
      <geom name="hinge_lower" type="cylinder" pos="-0.5 0 0.35" size="0.045 0.09" contype="0" conaffinity="0" rgba="0.6 0.62 0.65 1"/>
    </body>

    <body name="door" pos="-0.5 0 1.05">
      <joint name="hinge" type="hinge" pos="0 0 0" axis="0 0 1" limited="true" range="0 1.6" stiffness="24" springref="-0.08" damping="14" armature="0.02" solreflimit="0.01 1" solimplimit="0.99 0.999 0.001"/>
      <geom name="door_panel" type="box" pos="0.5 0 0" size="0.5 0.035 1" mass="8" rgba="0.48 0.25 0.10 1"/>
      <geom name="door_handle_stem" type="capsule" fromto="0.9 -0.035 0.05 0.9 -0.10 0.05" size="0.014" mass="0.015" rgba="0.75 0.73 0.55 1"/>
      <geom name="door_handle" type="sphere" pos="0.9 -0.10 0.05" size="0.03" mass="0.02" rgba="0.85 0.80 0.55 1"/>
    </body>
  </worldbody>

  <keyframe>
    <key name="start" qpos="1.25" qvel="0"/>
  </keyframe>
</mujoco>
